items.title: DICEU VTT — MULTIPLAYER VIRTUAL TABLETOP
items.description: Modular multiplayer virtual tabletop architected in Godot 4 with host/client ENet networking, server-authoritative board & 3D dice synchronization, chunked map streaming, and multi-geometry grid systems.

blocks.heading: TECHNICAL BREAKDOWN & ARCHITECTURE
blocks.content:
• Architected separated data, service, presentation, UI, and world layers with dedicated managers for campaigns, maps, grids, game state, networking, and synchronization.
• Implemented multiplayer networking using Godot ENet with host/client architecture, room-code authentication, admin/player roles, peer lifecycle management, and RPC communication.
• Developed server-authoritative board synchronization supporting late-joining clients and JSON-based local campaign persistence.
• Built map asset management supporting PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WebP with 512×512 chunk loading and compressed chunk-based network transfer.
• Engineered a unified grid system (square, pointy-hex, flat-hex), tactical measurement tools (distance, circle, triangle, rectangle, ping), networked 3D physics dice with transform-frame replay, and a dynamic initiative tracker.

items.title: ARTLAS — CROSS-PLATFORM CREATOR PLATFORM
items.description: Cross-platform creator application featuring a highly responsive Flutter frontend, decoupled presentation and canvas theme layers, and a secure Supabase backend pipeline.

blocks.heading: TECHNICAL BREAKDOWN & ARCHITECTURE
blocks.content:
• Architected a responsive frontend navbar and scaffold layout using Flutter and Provider state management with conditional breakpoints down to ultra-compact mobile viewports.
• Designed clean component architecture isolating presentation layers from underlying theme canvas states so transparent layout overlays pass seamlessly through parent scaffolds.
• Implemented secure development protocols using environment variable configurations (.env) integrated with a Supabase backend and Git tracking safety pipelines.

modules.title: UNIT DATA
modules.subtitle: BIOGRAPHY & SPECS
biography: I am Daryl Lundu Malson, a Full-Stack Developer and Software Engineer specializing in scalable backend architectures, responsive frontend interfaces, and clean, decoupled system design. From RESTful services in Spring Boot and Node.js to reactive web applications and enterprise portals, I turn complex operational requirements into maintainable, high-performance software.

Beyond enterprise and web engineering, I bridge rigorous systems architecture with interactive media and game development—building across Godot 4, Unity, and Unreal Engine with C++ and C#, while crafting 2D digital illustrations and frame-by-frame pixel animations in Krita and Aseprite.
